verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled or rule-based background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only developer primitives: webhooks that notify your app of enrollment or data changes, and a payments endpoint you call yourself. These are building blocks a developer could use to construct automations, not a product capability for setting up autonomous background automations, so they earn no credit.
